lessons.title: 申请系统访问权限
lines: Could you tell me how to request access to this system?
能告诉我怎样申请这个系统的权限吗？
request access＝申请使用权限
You'll need to submit an access request through the portal.
需要通过门户提交权限申请。
submit＝正式提交
Who needs to approve the request?
这项申请需要谁审批？
approve＝批准授权
Your team lead and the system owner.
你的团队负责人和系统负责人。
system owner＝对该系统负责的人
Can I choose read-only access for now?
我能先只申请只读权限吗？
read-only＝可以查看但不能修改
Yes, that's the recommended option if you only need to view data.
可以，如果只是看数据，建议选这个。
recommended＝推荐的选项
I don't need broader permissions than necessary.
我不需要超过实际需要的权限。
broader permissions＝范围更广的授权
Could you check whether the request is still pending?
能核对一下这项申请是否还在等待审批吗？
pending＝尚未处理完成
Once it's approved, I'll test that the access works.
通过后我会测试权限是否生效。
once＝一旦某事完成
Thanks for pointing me to the right process.
谢谢你告诉我正确的流程。
point me to＝指引我找到

lessons.title: 圣诞集市购物交流
lines: Excuse me, are these decorations handmade?
请问这些装饰品是手工制作的吗？
handmade＝手工制作
Yes, we make them locally in small batches.
是的，我们在本地小批量制作。
in small batches＝一次只生产少量
Could I have a closer look at this one?
能让我近一点看看这个吗？
have a closer look＝仔细看看
Of course. Please mind the delicate parts.
当然，请留意易损部件。
mind＝留意、小心
Do you take card payments at this stall?
你们这个摊位能刷卡吗？
stall＝集市摊位
Yes, card and cash are both fine.
可以，卡和现金都收。
both fine＝两种方式都可以
Is this suitable to pack in a suitcase?
这个适合装进行李箱吗？
suitable to pack＝适合打包携带
Could you wrap it so it doesn't break?
能包一下防止摔坏吗？
wrap it＝用包装材料裹好
I love the design, but I'm still looking around.
我很喜欢这个设计，不过还想再逛逛。
looking around＝继续看看别的商品
Thanks. I'll come back if I decide on it.
谢谢，决定好了我再回来。
decide on＝选定某一件

lessons.title: 线上故障信息同步
lines: Can you give us a brief update on the incident?
能简要同步一下这次故障吗？
incident＝生产环境中的故障事件
We're investigating a rise in failed requests.
我们正在调查请求失败数上升的问题。
a rise in＝某项指标增加
Do we know whether customers are affected?
我们知道客户是否受到影响吗？
affected＝受到实际影响
Some users are seeing errors when they sign in.
部分用户登录时遇到错误。
seeing errors＝操作过程中出现报错
Is there a workaround we can share safely?
有能安全告知用户的临时解决办法吗？
workaround＝临时绕过问题的方法
Not yet. We're still confirming the cause.
暂时没有，我们还在确认原因。
not yet＝到现在还没有
Let's separate confirmed facts from assumptions.
我们把已确认事实和推测分开。
assumptions＝未经证实的判断
Could we agree on the next update time?
能定一下下次同步时间吗？
next update time＝下一次发布进展的时间
I'd rather say we're investigating than guess a recovery time.
我宁愿说仍在排查，也不猜恢复时间。
rather … than …＝宁愿做前者而不是后者
I'll keep the incident log up to date.
我会持续更新故障记录。
up to date＝保持最新

lessons.title: 火车票退票咨询
lines: Hello, I'd like to ask about a refund for this ticket.
您好，我想咨询一下这张票的退款。
ask about a refund＝咨询退款是否适用
Was your journey cancelled or did you decide not to travel?
您的车次取消了，还是自己决定不出行？
cancelled＝车次被取消
The service was cancelled this morning.
今天早上这趟列车被取消了。
service＝此处指列车班次
Do you have the booking reference with you?
您带着预订编号吗？
booking reference＝订单识别编号
Yes, I can show it on my phone.
有，我可以在手机上出示。
show it on my phone＝展示电子订单
Thank you. I'll check which refund process applies.
谢谢，我核查一下适用哪种退款流程。
applies＝适用
Could you explain where I should submit the claim?
能解释一下应该在哪里提出申请吗？
submit a claim＝正式提交申请
Is there a deadline for submitting the form?
提交表单有截止日期吗？
deadline＝最后期限
I'd like to keep a copy of the confirmation.
我想保留一份确认记录。
keep a copy＝保存副本
Thanks. I'll follow the instructions you've given me.
谢谢，我会按照你提供的步骤操作。
follow instructions＝按说明执行

lessons.title: 变更审批流程
lines: Could we confirm whether this change needs approval?
能先确认这项变更是否需要审批吗？
needs approval＝需要正式授权
Yes, it affects a production configuration.
需要，它涉及生产配置。
production configuration＝正式运行环境设置
Who can sign off on the change?
谁可以最终批准这项变更？
sign off on＝正式批准
The service owner needs to review it first.
服务负责人需要先评审。
review＝检查并评估
Can we include a rollback plan in the request?
申请里能加上回退计划吗？
rollback plan＝变更出问题后如何恢复
Absolutely. We also need a way to verify success.
当然，我们还需要验证成功的方法。
verify success＝确认变更达到目标
I'd like to keep the change window short.
我希望把变更窗口控制得短一些。
change window＝允许变更的时间段
Let's make sure the customer impact is documented.
确保客户影响已经记录清楚。
documented＝有文字记录
Could you check the approval status this afternoon?
下午能帮忙查一下审批状态吗？
approval status＝申请进度
I won't deploy anything until the approval is confirmed.
没确认获批前我不会部署。
until＝在某事完成之前不做

lessons.title: 超市缺货时替换商品
lines: Excuse me, have you run out of this kind of bread?
请问这种面包卖完了吗？
run out of＝某种东西用完或售罄
I'm afraid it's sold out for today.
恐怕今天已经卖完了。
sold out＝售罄
Is there something similar you could recommend?
有类似的可以推荐吗？
something similar＝性质相近的替代品
This one is close in texture but has a different flavour.
这款口感相近，但味道不同。
texture＝食物的质地或口感
Does it contain the same ingredients?
它的配料一样吗？
ingredients＝食品原料
Not exactly. Please check the label if that matters.
不完全相同，如果配料对您很重要请核对标签。
not exactly＝不完全一致
Do you expect more stock tomorrow?
明天预计会补货吗？
more stock＝新的库存
Could I check another branch nearby?
我可以去附近另一家分店看看吗？
branch＝连锁商店的一个门店
I'll take this alternative if the ingredients are suitable.
如果配料合适，我就拿这个替代品。
alternative＝其他可选商品
Thanks for helping me find a replacement.
谢谢你帮我找到替代品。
replacement＝用于替代缺货商品的东西

lessons.title: 发布后回顾效果
lines: Can we check how the release has performed so far?
能看看这次发布到目前为止的表现吗？
so far＝截至当前
The error rate has stayed within our expected range.
错误率一直在预期范围内。
within the range＝没有超过指定范围
Have any customers reported unexpected behaviour?
有客户报告异常行为吗？
unexpected behaviour＝系统出现非预期表现
Just one minor display issue, which we're tracking.
只有一个小的显示问题，我们正在跟踪。
tracking＝持续记录和跟进
Are the main business actions still working normally?
主要业务操作仍能正常使用吗？
business actions＝用户最关键的业务操作
Yes, the checks passed after deployment.
是的，部署后检查都通过了。
passed＝通过验证
Let's compare the results with the pre-release baseline.
我们与发布前的基准数据比较一下。
baseline＝用来比较的原始基准
I'd like to know whether the new flow is actually faster.
我想知道新流程是否真的更快。
actually＝强调真实结果而非猜测
Could we keep monitoring until the next review?
能继续观察到下次评审吗？
keep monitoring＝持续监控
I'll share a short report with the team tomorrow.
明天我会给团队发一份简报。
short report＝简短情况总结

lessons.title: 圣诞节节日问候
lines: Are you taking a few days off over Christmas?
圣诞节期间你会休几天假吗？
take days off＝请假或休假
Yes, I'm visiting my family for a couple of days.
会，我要去陪家人几天。
a couple of days＝大约两天，口语中有时泛指短短几天
I hope you have a lovely break.
祝你假期愉快。
lovely＝英式常见的温暖、友好表达
Thanks, and I hope you enjoy yours too.
谢谢，也祝你假期愉快。
yours＝你的假期
Are you staying in town over the holidays?
节日期间你留在城里吗？
staying in town＝不离开本地
Probably. I may meet a few friends for lunch.
可能吧，我也许会约朋友吃午饭。
may＝可能，不是已经确定
Have you got any plans for the long weekend?
长周末有什么安排吗？
have you got＝口语里询问是否有计划
I'm keeping things fairly quiet this year.
今年我打算过得比较清静。
keep things quiet＝安排低调、轻松
Enjoy the rest of your holiday.
接下来的假期也祝你愉快。
the rest of＝剩余部分
See you when we're both back at work.
等我们都回去上班再见。
back at work＝假期后重新工作

lessons.title: 确认软件版本兼容
lines: Which version of the library are we using?
我们现在使用哪个版本的库？
library＝开发中复用的代码组件
The service is still on the previous minor version.
服务还在用上一个次版本。
minor version＝版本号中通常表示较小更新的一部分
Does the new client support that version?
新客户端兼容这个版本吗？
support＝能够正常配合使用
Not fully. One endpoint behaves differently.
不完全兼容，有一个接口行为不同。
endpoint＝API 的一个访问入口
Can we check the compatibility notes before upgrading?
升级前能先看兼容性说明吗？
compatibility notes＝版本之间能否互通的说明
Yes, and we should test the old integration as well.
可以，也应该测试旧对接。
as well＝同样也需要
I'd rather avoid changing both sides at once.
我希望避免两边同时改动。
at once＝同时
Let's pin the working version for this release.
这次发布先锁定已验证可用的版本吧。
pin the version＝固定依赖版本
Could you record the supported versions in the README?
能在 README 中记录支持的版本吗？
supported versions＝已验证兼容的版本
I'll add a test for mixed-version communication.
我会添加新旧版本混用时的通信测试。
mixed-version＝多版本同时存在的情况

lessons.title: 咖啡馆接待朋友
lines: Have you been waiting long?
你等很久了吗？
been waiting long＝关心对方是否等了很久
Not at all. I only got here five minutes ago.
没有，我才到五分钟。
not at all＝一点也没有
Shall we order before we sit down?
我们坐下前先点单好吗？
shall we＝自然地提出一起做某事
Good idea. I'll have a flat white.
好主意，我要一杯馥芮白。
flat white＝常见浓缩咖啡加奶饮品
Would you like to sit by the window?
你想坐窗边吗？
by the window＝在窗户旁
Yes, it's a bit quieter over there.
想，那边安静一点。
over there＝那边
What have you been up to lately?
你最近在忙些什么？
be up to＝口语里做什么、忙什么
Mostly work, but I've found time to explore the city.
主要忙工作，不过也抽空逛了城市。
find time to＝抽空做某事
We should do this again before you leave.
你走之前我们应该再聚一次。
do this again＝下次再这样见面
Definitely. I'll message you next week.
一定，下周我发消息给你。
definitely＝肯定

lessons.title: 讲解系统架构图
lines: Could you walk us through the architecture diagram?
能带大家看一下系统架构图吗？
walk through＝按顺序讲解
Sure. I'll start with the main request flow.
可以，我先从主要请求流程讲起。
request flow＝请求在组件之间流转的路径
Where does the user request enter the system?
用户请求从哪里进入系统？
enter the system＝进入系统的入口
It first reaches the gateway, which routes it to a service.
首先到网关，再由网关转发到服务。
gateway＝统一接收和转发请求的入口
What happens if that service is unavailable?
如果那个服务不可用会怎样？
unavailable＝无法正常提供服务
The gateway returns an error; we don't retry indefinitely.
网关返回错误，我们不会无限重试。
indefinitely＝没有终止条件地持续
Let's trace one request from start to finish.
我们从头到尾跟踪一个请求吧。
trace＝沿流程逐步追踪
I'd like to understand where the state is stored.
我想弄清楚状态存在哪里。
state＝系统需要保留的运行信息
Could you mark the external dependencies on the diagram?
能在图上标出外部依赖吗？
external dependencies＝依赖的外部系统或服务
I'll update the drawing after we confirm the data flow.
数据流确认后我会更新这张图。
data flow＝数据如何移动和处理

lessons.title: 节礼日退换商品
lines: Hello, I'd like to ask about returning this gift.
您好，我想咨询一下这份礼物的退货事宜。
returning＝退货
Do you have a receipt or gift receipt?
您有收据或礼品收据吗？
gift receipt＝赠礼时提供的收据
I have a gift receipt, but I didn't buy it myself.
我有礼品收据，但不是我买的。
didn't buy it myself＝自己不是原购买人
That's fine. I'll check what exchange options apply.
没关系，我看一下适用什么换货方式。
exchange options＝可选换货办法
Could I exchange it for a different size?
我能换一个尺码吗？
exchange … for＝把一种商品换成另一种
We'll need to check whether your size is in stock.
我们得先看您需要的尺码是否有货。
in stock＝有库存
Does your holiday returns policy cover this item?
节日期间的退换政策涵盖这件商品吗？
returns policy＝商家退货政策；各店不同
I'd like to understand the conditions before deciding.
我想先了解条件，再决定。
conditions＝适用的要求和限制
If an exchange isn't possible, what are my options?
如果不能换货，还有什么选择？
what are my options＝询问可行选择
Thanks for explaining the store policy.
谢谢你解释店里的政策。
store policy＝该商店自己的规则

lessons.title: 会议中处理敏感信息
lines: Can we check whether this document is confidential?
能确认一下这份文件是否保密吗？
confidential＝不能随意公开或传播
Yes, it contains information limited to this project.
是的，里面有仅限该项目的信息。
limited to＝限定可访问范围
Should we avoid putting those figures on the shared screen?
共享屏幕时要不要避免展示那些数字？
avoid doing＝避免某种操作
That would be safer until we confirm the audience.
在确认参会人员前，那样更稳妥。
audience＝能看到或听到这些信息的人员
Could we discuss the sensitive points in a smaller group?
能在更小范围讨论敏感问题吗？
smaller group＝缩小参与人员范围
Yes, we'll arrange a separate meeting with authorised people.
可以，我们和有权限的人另开会。
authorised＝已获授权
Let's remove personal details from the example first.
我们先把示例里的个人信息去掉。
personal details＝可以识别个人的信息
I'd rather share a redacted version with the wider team.
我更愿意给大团队分享脱敏版本。
redacted＝隐去敏感信息的
Can we confirm where the file should be stored?
能确定这个文件应该存在哪里吗？
where stored＝文件的合规存放位置
I'll follow the company's data-handling rules.
我会遵守公司的数据处理规则。
data-handling＝数据保存、共享、使用的要求

lessons.title: 航班延误后延住酒店
lines: My flight has been delayed, so I may need another night.
我的航班延误了，可能需要多住一晚。
another night＝额外住一晚
Let me check whether we have a room available.
我查一下是否还有房间。
available＝可预订
Could I stay in the same room if possible?
如果可以，我能继续住原来的房间吗？
stay in the same room＝续住时不换房
Yes, we can extend your current booking.
可以，我们能延长您现在的预订。
extend a booking＝把预订时间加长
Would the extra night be charged at the same rate?
额外一晚也是同样房价吗？
rate＝房价
The rate is slightly different for tonight.
今晚的价格稍有不同。
slightly＝稍微
Could you send me an updated booking confirmation?
能发给我更新后的预订确认吗？
updated confirmation＝修改后的确认记录
I'd like to check with the airline before I confirm.
正式确认前我想先向航空公司核实。
check with＝向相关方确认
What time would I need to check out tomorrow?
如果明天离店，最晚几点退房？
check out＝退房
Thanks. I'll let you know as soon as I hear back.
谢谢，一收到回复我就通知你。
hear back＝收到对方答复

lessons.title: 制定新年目标与计划
lines: Could we discuss the main goals for next quarter?
我们能讨论一下下季度的主要目标吗？
next quarter＝下一个季度
I'd like to focus on reliability before new features.
我想先提高稳定性，再做新功能。
reliability＝系统持续可靠运行的能力
What's the biggest risk we should address first?
我们应该优先处理的最大风险是什么？
address a risk＝采取措施处理风险
The recurring connection failures need attention.
反复发生的连接失败问题需要处理。
recurring＝反复出现的
Do we have a measurable target for improvement?
改进有没有可衡量的目标？
measurable target＝可量化的目标
We could track failure rate and recovery time.
可以跟踪失败率和恢复时间。
track＝持续记录指标
Let's avoid taking on more than the team can deliver.
我们别接超过团队交付能力的工作。
take on＝承担新的任务
I'd rather agree on a few clear priorities.
我更希望先统一几个明确的优先事项。
a few clear priorities＝少数明确重点
Can we review the plan after the first month?
第一个月过后能回顾计划吗？
review the plan＝根据执行情况复盘计划
I'll prepare a draft roadmap for our next meeting.
下次会议前我会准备路线图草稿。
roadmap＝阶段性工作路线规划

lessons.title: 节假日期间确认营业
lines: Excuse me, are you open over the bank holiday?
请问公共假日期间你们营业吗？
bank holiday＝英国的法定公众假日之一
We have different hours this week.
这周营业时间有所调整。
different hours＝和平常不同的营业时间
What time do you close tomorrow?
你们明天几点关门？
close＝商店停止营业
We'll close earlier than usual.
我们会比平时早关门。
earlier than usual＝比平常提前
Is the café open even if the shop is closed?
即使商店关闭，咖啡馆还开吗？
even if＝即便某条件成立
Let me check the café's separate timetable.
我查一下咖啡馆单独的营业安排。
separate timetable＝另一套时间安排
Could I book a table in advance?
我能提前订位吗？
in advance＝事先
Is the website showing the latest holiday hours?
网站展示的是最新节日营业时间吗？
latest hours＝更新后的营业安排
I'd rather confirm before travelling across town.
我宁愿先确认，免得白跑一趟。
across town＝穿过城区到另一侧
Thanks, I'll make a note of the closing time.
谢谢，我会记下关门时间。
make a note of＝记下来

lessons.title: 请假前交接工作
lines: Could we go over the open tasks before I take leave?
我休假前能一起过一下未完成任务吗？
take leave＝休假
Yes, let's start with anything time-sensitive.
可以，先看有时间限制的事情。
time-sensitive＝需要在特定时间前处理
Who can cover urgent customer questions while I'm away?
我不在时谁能处理紧急客户问题？
cover＝临时代为负责
I can be the first contact for those requests.
我可以作为这些请求的第一联系人。
first contact＝第一个应该联系的人
Do you need the latest status of each issue?
你需要每个问题的最新状态吗？
latest status＝目前进展
Yes, and any next steps you've already agreed.
需要，还有你已确认的后续步骤。
next steps＝接下来要做的动作
I'll leave a short handover note in the shared folder.
我会在共享文件夹留份简短交接说明。
handover note＝交接记录
Let's make sure deadlines and owners are clear.
确保截止时间和责任人都清楚。
owners＝对任务负责的人
I don't want to be a single point of failure.
我不希望只有我知道怎么处理，成为单点风险。
single point of failure＝一个环节失效就影响整体的风险点
Thanks. I'll be back at work next Tuesday.
谢谢，我下周二回来上班。
back at work＝恢复上班

lessons.title: 等待预订餐桌
lines: Hello, we have a booking for two under Chen.
您好，我们用 Chen 这个姓订了两人桌。
under Chen＝预订登记在 Chen 名下
Yes, I can see it here. Your table isn't quite ready.
看到了，您的桌位还没完全准备好。
isn't quite ready＝还差一点才准备好
Do you know roughly how long we'll need to wait?
大概还要等多久？
roughly＝大约
It should be another ten minutes or so.
应该还要十分钟左右。
or so＝左右、大约
Would it be all right to wait near the bar?
我们可以在吧台附近等吗？
would it be all right＝礼貌征求许可
Certainly. We'll call your name when it's ready.
当然，准备好后会叫您的名字。
call your name＝叫号或喊姓名
Could we have some water while we wait?
等的时候可以给我们一些水吗？
while we wait＝等待期间
We're not in a rush, so that's absolutely fine.
我们不赶时间，完全没问题。
not in a rush＝不着急
Please let us know if the wait is likely to be longer.
如果预计要等更久，请告诉我们。
likely to＝可能
Thank you. We'll be just over there.
谢谢，我们就在那边等。
just over there＝就在不远处

lessons.title: 回顾年度经验教训
lines: Could we finish the year by reviewing what we've learned?
年底我们能回顾一下学到的经验吗？
finish the year by＝以某种方式结束这一年
Yes, especially the changes that improved delivery.
可以，尤其是那些改善交付的改动。
improved delivery＝提升交付过程和结果
What worked better than we expected?
哪些事情比预期做得更好？
better than expected＝优于原先预计
Early customer testing gave us useful feedback.
提前让客户测试带来了有用反馈。
early testing＝在较早阶段开展测试
Where did we lose the most time?
我们在哪些地方耽误最多时间？
lose time＝因低效或问题损失时间
Unclear dependencies caused a lot of rework.
不明确的依赖导致了大量返工。
rework＝重复修改已做的工作
Let's focus on changes we can actually make next year.
我们聚焦明年真正能实施的改进吧。
actually make＝能落实，而不只是讨论
I'd like to keep the review constructive and specific.
我希望复盘有建设性、且足够具体。
constructive＝有助于改进
Could we agree on three priorities to carry forward?
我们能统一三个延续到明年的重点吗？
carry forward＝延续到下一阶段
I'll share the summary before everyone goes on leave.
大家休假前我会分享总结。
go on leave＝开始休假

lessons.title: 规划返程交通
lines: What's the easiest way to get to the airport from here?
从这里去机场最方便怎么走？
easiest way＝最省事的路线
There's a direct train from the central station.
中央车站有直达列车。
direct train＝途中无需换乘
How early should I leave for a morning flight?
赶早班飞机应该提前多久出发？
how early＝需要提前的时长
I'd allow some extra time in case of delays.
我会多留些时间，以防延误。
allow extra time＝额外预留时间
Is the train running normally tomorrow?
明天火车正常运行吗？
running normally＝按正常安排运行
Check the operator's updates before you travel.
出行前查看运营方更新。
operator＝交通服务运营公司
Could you help me check the right terminal?
能帮我确认正确的航站楼吗？
right terminal＝航班对应的正确航站楼
I'll keep my passport and boarding pass handy.
我会把护照和登机牌放在容易拿到的地方。
handy＝随手可取
It's been a lovely trip. Thanks for all your help.
这次旅程很愉快，谢谢你一路的帮助。
lovely＝英式常见的“美好、愉快”
See you next time, and have a safe journey.
下次见，祝一路平安。
have a safe journey＝祝旅途安全
